method: linear program minimizing the exact rates.bill_nem_monthly objective (36 month/season/period netting buckets + NBC on gross imports), solved via scipy.optimize.linprog (HiGHS), at identical capacity/power/efficiency/EV-exclusion constraints as battery_dispatch_policies.run_batt's greedy policy, with a cyclic (steady-state) SOC boundary

day_ahead_forecast.forecast_method: persistence: yesterday's actual house-net profile (Consumption - Generation), time-of-day aligned, used as tomorrow's forecast; the first day of the year persists from the last day (cyclic)

purchasing_statement.note: what a smarter (day-ahead-forecast) controller is worth over the shipping greedy policy, and what is still left even after that upgrade, at the same 13.5 kWh / 11.5 kW hardware -- no shipping product changes the CONTROLLER, only the hardware, so this gap is a software/firmware question, not a purchasing one
